purpose: 固定三项已发现官方方法原件的一次取得与原文抽取，不以搜索摘要准入到期规则
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
import hashlib,json,requests,re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_domestic_reverse_repo_maturity_prior_source_review_v1'
ITEMS=[
 {'id':'M01','url':'https://www.chinamoney.com.cn/english/rarrmrrudmrl/20161111/2025.html','question':'银行间一般债券交易规则对首期/到期及结算日的定义，是否明确适用央行常规公开市场操作'},
 {'id':'M02','url':'https://www.shclearing.com.cn/cpyyw/tzgg/202312/t20231227_1349574.html','question':'2023年12月31日银行间本币特殊交易/结算日，是否说明不能直接使用股票交易日历'},
 {'id':'M03','url':'https://www.pbc.gov.cn/goutongjiaoliu/113456/113469/2025092212541931588/index.html','question':'登记托管结算管理办法是否明示央行常规公开市场逆回购资金起日/到期推导规则'}]
def h(blob): return hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
def save_json(path,obj):
 if path.exists(): raise RuntimeError('拒绝覆盖原来源回执：'+str(path))
 path.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def acquire(item):
 record={**item,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'attempts':1}
 try:
  with requests.Session() as session:
   response=session.get(item['url'],timeout=(10,25),stream=True,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 510300 historical source review'})
   chunks=[];size=0
   for chunk in response.iter_content(65536):
    size+=len(chunk)
    if size>20971520: raise RuntimeError('本次原对象超过冻结单件上限')
    chunks.append(chunk)
   blob=b''.join(chunks)
   raw=OUT/'sources'/('方法原件_'+item['id']+'.html')
   if raw.exists(): raise RuntimeError('原件路径已经存在：'+str(raw))
   raw.write_bytes(blob)
   record.update({'status_code':response.status_code,'final_url':response.url,'redirects':[{'status_code':z.status_code,'url':z.url} for z in response.history],
       'response_headers':dict(response.headers),'bytes':len(blob),'sha256':h(blob),'raw_path':str(raw.relative_to(ROOT)).replace(chr(92),'/')})
   text=blob.decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
   soup=BeautifulSoup(text,'lxml')
   for tag in soup(['script','style','noscript']): tag.decompose()
   body=soup.get_text(' ',strip=True)
   txt=OUT/'sources'/('方法文本_'+item['id']+'.txt')
   if txt.exists(): raise RuntimeError('文本路径已存在')
   txt.write_text(body+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
   keywords=['公开市场','逆回购','起息','首次结算','首期结算','到期结算','节假','首次结算日','DueSettlement','First Settlement','business day','settlement date','repo period']
   contexts=[]
   for key in keywords:
    for match in re.finditer(re.escape(key),body,re.IGNORECASE):
     contexts.append({'term':key,'context':body[max(0,match.start()-130):min(len(body),match.end()+300)]})
   links=[]
   for anchor in soup.find_all('a',href=True):
    label=anchor.get_text(' ',strip=True)
    if any(k in label for k in ['公开市场','债券交易规则','债券回购','主协议','交易规程','业务规则']):
     links.append({'label':label,'href':anchor['href']})
   record.update({'title':soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if soup.title else None,'keyword_contexts':contexts,
       'method_navigation_links':links,'text_path':str(txt.relative_to(ROOT)).replace(chr(92),'/'),
       'admission':'PENDING_EXACT_APPLICABILITY_REVIEW','historical_known_status':'CURRENT_METHOD_TEXT_HISTORY_NOT_AUTOMATICALLY_CERTIFIED'})
 except Exception as error:
  record['request_error']=str(error)
  record['admission']='NOT_ESTABLISHED_REQUEST_OR_PARSE_ERROR'
 record['completed_at']=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
 return record
save_json(OUT/'03次原方法请求清单.json',{'registered_before_request':True,'direct_request_budget_total':8,'this_request_items':ITEMS,'catalog_queries_already_used':4,'future_retries_authorized':False})
records=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
 futures=[pool.submit(acquire,item) for item in ITEMS]
 for future in as_completed(futures):
  item=future.result();records.append(item)
  print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in item.items() if k in ['id','status_code','title','request_error','bytes','final_url']},ensure_ascii=False))
records.sort(key=lambda x:x['id'])
if sum(x.get('bytes',0) for x in records)>67108864: raise RuntimeError('本次累计原件超限')
save_json(OUT/'官方方法原响应索引_01.json',{'new_direct_requests':len(ITEMS),'catalog_queries_used':4,'records':records})
for item in records:
 print(json.dumps({'id':item['id'],'question':item['question'],'keyword_contexts':item.get('keyword_contexts',[]),'method_navigation_links':item.get('method_navigation_links',[])},ensure_ascii=False))
